channel.title: Bbabsal Research
channel.description: Independent, evidence led analysis of critical minerals, refining capacity, method, markets and policy.

item.title: The 2026 copper forecasts agreed on the direction. The price went the other way.
item.description: Two independent forecasters called a small 2026 copper surplus. The price traded well above the range that surplus was expected to enforce. What that says about reading balance forecasts, and the concentrate constraint underneath.

item.title: The United States mines more copper than it refines
item.description: Ten years of United States Geological Survey data on American copper refinery output, net import reliance, and where the world's refining capacity sits.
